    • 3.5 SDK Control Ownership
      • Control Authority Between SDK and App
        • Scenario 1: The App Connects First, Followed by the SDK. Control authority is held by the App, and the SDK cannot control the robot.
        • Scenario 2: The SDK Connects First, Followed by the App. Control authority is held by the SDK. The App cannot control the robot, but it can forcibly preempt the SDK’s control authority.

msg

Field

Default

Range

Front LiDAR point cloud: /front_lidar
Rear LiDAR point cloud: /rear_lidar

sensor_msgs::msg::PointCloud2
（Qos::best_effort）

std_msgs/Header

header

ROS2 standard message header

10hz

uint32

height

Vertical height of the point cloud (rows)

uint32

width

Horizontal width of the point cloud (columns)

PointField[]

Field descriptors for each channel in the point cloud

bool

Whether the data is in big‑endian byte order

uint32

point_step

Number of bytes per point

uint32

row_step

Number of bytes per row of point data

uint8[]

data

Raw binary point cloud data as a 1D array

bool

Whether the point cloud is dense (i.e., contains no invalid points)

Front LiDAR IP: 192.168.1.102
Rear LiDAR IP: 192.168.2.102

4.2.2 Retrieving LiDAR Data

ssh robot@192.168.168.100   
ros2 topic echo /front_lidar --once
ros2 topic echo /rear_lidar --once
